guide.intro: Read fortunes and play mini-games with your bias to raise your Mini Bias in Chemi.
guide.growthDetail: Sign in and finish a reading or game to earn bond EXP for the bias you chose. You can earn it once a day per activity and bias. Each kind of reading awards EXP to up to three biases per day.

home.datePricing: Open a fortune for another date for 10M. Miles earned through activities are used first. You can revisit unlocked readings. Game limits reset at midnight in Korea.
home.gamePricing: Each game has three free plays a day. Extra plays cost 10M, 30M and 50M in order. From the fourth, each costs 100M with no daily limit.
